# Environmental Contractor Insurance

> Specialized commercial insurance for environmental remediation, abatement, and hazmat contractors — Contractors Pollution Liability (CPL), general liability (written around the pollution exclusion), professional liability/E&O, workers' compensation for asbestos/mold/lead abatement, commercial auto for vacuum trucks and tankers, inland marine/mobile equipment, commercial property, and umbrella/excess. A division of Contractors Choice Agency (founded 2005, licensed all 50 states, NPN 8608479). A-rated carriers, 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response.

Environmental Contractor Insurance helps environmental remediation and hazmat contractors get coverage that actually fits the work: standalone Contractors Pollution Liability (CPL) instead of a worthless pollution endorsement, correctly class-coded abatement workers' comp, mobile equipment that travels with the crew, and commercial auto rated for hazmat hauling. We shop A-rated environmental specialty markets and turn around the certificates and additional-insured endorsements — with pollution extensions — that refineries, GCs, developers, and government clients require.

## Coverage lines
- [Contractors Pollution Liability (CPL)](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/pollution-liability): Standalone pollution coverage for asbestos, mold, lead, contaminated soil/groundwater, and hazardous waste — the core policy standard GL excludes.
- [General Liability](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/general-liability): Third-party bodily injury & property damage for environmental operations — coordinated with CPL because GL excludes pollution.
- [Professional Liability / E&O](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/professional-liability): Coverage for remediation design, sampling, assessment, and consulting errors.
- [Workers' Compensation](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/workers-compensation): Asbestos, mold, and lead abatement class codes — exposure, confined-space, and disease claims handled right.
- [Commercial Auto](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/commercial-auto): Vacuum trucks, tankers, roll-offs, and super-suckers rated for hazmat hauling.
- [Commercial Property](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/commercial-property): Remediation yard, decontamination facility, office, and contaminated-gear storage.
- [Inland Marine / Mobile Equipment](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/inland-marine-equipment): Excavators, frac tanks, HEPA vacs, air monitors, and confined-space gear at replacement cost.
- [Umbrella / Excess Liability](https://environmentalcontractorsinsurance.com/services/umbrella-excess-liability): Layered limits to $10M+ for catastrophic contamination losses and high-limit client requirements.
